methods.strata: Original returns normalized against the supported 1 m DTM. Excludes classes 7/12/18, withheld points, roof candidates plus 2 m, unsupported cells and heights outside [-1,80] m. Negative residuals join bin 0. Integer-metre bins [k,k+1); counts shown in six height bands. Low-layer share uses 2–5 m returns / all returns >=2 m. Entropy is Shannon / ln(79) across fixed 1 m bins 2..80, null for no elevated returns. All vs first returns are separately counted, not independent repeated surveys.
methods.texture: Mean population SD of the normalized height surface in 5×5 m windows. Only complete eligible 25-cell windows contribute; missing/roof neighborhoods stay missing. Plot SD/P95 use all eligible height cells. Rugosity depends on the selected 5 m scale and includes crown/opening transitions; it is not a biodiversity or maturity score.
methods.edges: Taller-canopy proxy is eligible height >5 m; low-opening proxy <=2 m. Euclidean cell-centre distance to known openings. Edge is canopy within 10/20/30 m; interior is farther from both known openings and unknown/roof/tile boundaries; remaining canopy is censored. Counts partition canopy cells exactly. Distances are horizontal; polygons are plot aggregates, not measured forest edges.

limitations: No authoritative forest mask or source vegetation class: unrecognized structures can remain.
Airborne returns are affected by occlusion, acquisition settings and multiple returns; profiles are not vegetation volume, leaf area or a seedling inventory.
Edge/interior proxies do not establish habitat quality, species occurrence, fire risk, tree age or windthrow risk.
One acquisition supports structure screening, not change detection; biomass/species/productivity need independent training/reference data.
